name: Yuela
source:
She is summoned to the Guaracuna fortress with a "fairy" persona complete with matching outfit whilst on her travels.

The identity of her fairy outfit designer is unknown. Adding insult to injury, despite her magical girl appearance she is completely incapable of using magic and is far more comfortable fighting on the front lines with her greatsword (with a modified appearance resembling a magic staff)

[Spoiler] Exceedingly fond of cats and will venture into the depths of the Guaracuna fortress and the unstable parallel worlds within to save stranded felines. 

Once her character-specific weapons are crafted, she is able to use long-range offensive magic as a special ability intrinsic to each weapon. A special building is also unlocked allowing players to choose her appearance (either her guest appearance outfit or her original outfit from Kamidori Alchemy Meister) [/Spoiler]
